sources.description: According to multiple reports, including NFL Network’s lead insider Ian Rapoport, the Denver Broncos have re-signed quarterback Sam Ehlinger to a one-year deal worth $2 million dollars. The Broncos continue to re-sign their own players, this time bringing back third-string quarterback Sam Ehlinger. He joined the Broncos last season and seemed to really enjoy his […]
